profile.headline: Engineering & Technology Leader | Career Mentor | Helping Engineers Grow | Passionate About People, Technology & Growth
profile.summary:
I’m an engineering and technology leader with over 20 years of experience in embedded software, engineering leadership, and helping teams and organizations grow.

Currently at General Motors, I lead engineering teams developing foundational software for next-generation vehicles. Throughout my career, I’ve enjoyed solving complex technical challenges, building strong teams, and finding better ways to deliver meaningful results.

I’m passionate about continuous improvement and organizational transformation. I enjoy looking beyond individual problems to understand how people, processes, and technology work together, identifying bottlenecks, simplifying complexity, and creating systems that help teams succeed.

I’m also excited about the possibilities of AI and automation, particularly how they can eliminate repetitive work, improve decision-making, and allow people to focus on higher-value activities.

But what I find equally rewarding is helping people grow.

Over the years, I’ve had the opportunity to hire, coach, and mentor professionals at different stages of their careers. There’s something incredibly fulfilling about helping someone recognize their strengths, navigate challenges, or discover opportunities they hadn’t considered before.

I believe growth comes from staying curious, challenging ourselves, and continuously finding ways to create greater impact. It’s a mindset I bring to technology, leadership, process improvement, and personal development.

Beyond my day-to-day role, I’m exploring ways to share my experience with technology and engineering professionals navigating career decisions, preparing for interviews, or looking for their next opportunity to grow.

I always enjoy connecting with people who are passionate about technology, leadership, AI, continuous improvement, and personal growth.

Feel free to connect or message me. I’d love to exchange ideas, experiences, and opportunities to grow.

positions.title: Engineering Group Manager | Electrification Propulsion & Motion Supervisory Controls
positions.description:
• Established and implemented team operating processes, clarified roles and responsibilities, and strengthened collaboration, engineering quality, and software delivery across an evolving engineering organization.

• Led engineering teams through the successful release of safety-critical propulsion supervisory control software for GM’s software-defined vehicle platform.

• Coached and mentored engineers to strengthen technical capabilities, improve performance, and prepare for career advancement and future leadership opportunities.

positions.title: Engineering Group Manager - Mechatronics Software Platform
positions.description:
• Built multiple engineering teams from the ground up, establishing team structures, technical capabilities, and operating processes.

• Led multiple engineering teams across diverse technologies, delivering foundational mechatronics infrastructure software for current production vehicles and GM’s next-generation software-defined vehicle platform.

• Drove software development, integration, and production support across multiple vehicle platforms, balancing current product needs with future technology development.

positions.title: SAFe Program Consultant / Enterprise Agile Transformation Coach
positions.description:
• Designed and led enterprise Agile transformation strategies across organizations of 400+ people, coaching engineering teams and leaders to improve organizational effectiveness.

• Mapped and established value streams, designed Agile operating models, and implemented planning cadences and cross-team coordination processes to improve collaboration and delivery predictability.

• Coached senior leaders and executives on Agile adoption, organizational transformation, systems thinking, and continuous improvement to identify bottlenecks and improve value delivery.
positions.insights: Seven Habits of Highly Effective People
